qualification.details: Assistant Responsible Officer: Post Graduate degree in Social Work/Sociology/Child Development/Human Rights/Public Administration/Psychiatry/Law/Public Health/Community Resource Management. At least 3 years of experience in Documentation, training & Capacity Building, Project formulation/implementation, monitoring and supervision preferably in Women & Child Development/Social Welfare. Proficiency in Computers. Home Superintendent Officer: Graduate preferably in B.A in Social Work/Sociology/Social Sciences or LLB. Experience of at least 2 years in Govt./NGO/Legal Matters preferably in Women & Child Rights. Good understanding of Women & Child right & protection issues. Proficiency in Computers. Counselor: Master's degree in Psychology. Preference for candidates with experience working with children in conflict with the law. Store Keeper and Accountant: Graduate in Commerce/Mathematics. At least 1-year experience in the desired field. Computer Skills & command on Tally. House Father/Mother: 12th pass. Nursing Assistant: 10th pass and completed a training course for Nursing Assistant. Teacher: Diploma in Teacher Education (D.Ed.) OR Bachelor's Degree in Teacher Education. Art and Music Teacher: Certificate/Diploma/Bachelor's Degree in Drawing and Painting or a Certificate/Diploma/Bachelor's Degree in Music. Yoga Trainer: Certificate/Diploma/Bachelor's Degree in Yoga. Cook: 8th pass. Night Watchman: 8th pass. House Keeper: 8th pass.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Chengalpattu Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: http://chengalpattu.nic.in.
